[Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/ethiopia_near_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Ethiopia to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data, classifying geographic areas into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity. Data were compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML geographic datasets for 2021 near-term projections.
